title: Conflicts in Texts: Data, Implications and Challenges

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying methods and datasets for ideology detection, stance detection, and the analysis of media framing and informational bias across partisan news sources.

Reviewing literature on how annotator demographics and personal identities influence subjective labeling, such as the misclassification of African American English in hate speech and toxicity detection.

Synthesizing research that evaluates models' Western-centric skews by comparing model performance and alignment on culturally sensitive topics, different languages, and underrepresented geographic regions.
